text: Probably wasting your time but here goes. Granddaughter, 7 months, has the chickenpox. Spots are itchy and she keeps rubbing at them but she's well otherwise. She's been warm on and off today, we've been giving her the baby paracetamol and in between she's playing, drinking her milk and babbling away like normal. Colour's fine, lips nice and pink. Her mum's asleep and I said I'd ring. Is there anything to do for the itching at this age or do we just leave it
